specs.Item Highlight: Ultra Clear Back Scratch-Proof Light TPU Back with Featuring Auto Wake Sleep & Multi Angle Folding Stand

features: DETACHABLE FOLIO CASE FOR KOBO LIBRA COLOUR: This slim protective cover is designed for the 7 inch Kobo Libra Colour. It features a unique detachable front cover for flexible usage. Use the full folio for complete protection or detach the front cover for a lightweight reading experience with just the transparent back shell.

AUTO WAKE SLEEP FUNCTION: The smart cover enables instant screen response to optimize battery life. Opening the cover wakes your device while closing it puts it to sleep, ensuring a seamless user experience. Beyond its smart features, the reinforced corners and soft TPU back provide protection against accidental drops and impacts.

CLEAR BACK DESIGN: The ultra clear PC back resists yellowing over time, allowing you to showcase the original beauty of your device. This transparent surface provides a creative space where you can display stickers, artwork, or photos to personalize your reader. The smooth finish is easy to clean and maintains long term clarity, ensuring your device looks fresh.

MULTI ANGLE FOLDING STAND: The front cover folds into various positions, providing multiple viewing angles for hands free reading on a desk or table. Whether you are following a recipe or relaxing with a novel, this stand ensures a comfortable posture. Thoughtfully crafted cutouts provide full access to buttons, ports, and sensors.

SLIM LIGHTWEIGHT PROFILE: Designed for portability, this thin case adds minimal weight to your bag or backpack. It is an ideal companion for travel, commuting, or reading at home. The lightweight construction ensures that your hands do not get tired during long reading sessions.
description: Detachable Case for 7 Inch Kobo Libra
